import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

# Let's inspect objects in obs_0001.png
# Let's list the distinct color clusters in obs_0001
arr = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png').convert('RGB'))

# Mask out ceiling (y < 211, dark)
# Mask out wall (white: > 240 in all channels)
# Mask out floor (around [165, 158, 142])

not_ceil = arr[:, :, 0] > 60
not_wall = ~((arr[:, :, 0] > 240) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 240) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 240))
# floor has R~150-180, G~140-170, B~130-160 and R > G > B
not_floor = ~((arr[:, :, 0] > 140) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 185) & 
              (arr[:, :, 1] > 130) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 175) & 
              (arr[:, :, 2] > 120) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 165) &
              (arr[:, :, 0] >= arr[:, :, 1]) & (arr[:, :, 1] >= arr[:, :, 2]))

obj_mask = not_ceil & not_wall & not_floor

# Connected components or color clustering
from scipy.ndimage import label
labeled, num_features = label(obj_mask)
print('Number of object connected components:', num_features)

for i in range(1, num_features + 1):
    ys, xs = np.where(labeled == i)
    if len(ys) > 50:
        c_mean = arr[ys, xs].mean(axis=0).astype(int)
        print(f'Comp {i}: size={len(ys):5d}, x=[{xs.min():3d}, {xs.max():3d}], y=[{ys.min():3d}, {ys.max():3d}], mean_rgb={c_mean}')
"
